name: learn-quize
comment: Pinned to Expo SDK 54 on purpose. Expo Go on the iOS App Store is capped at 54.0.2 (Sept 2025) and there is no newer iOS client, so SDK 54 is the highest version testable on a physical iPhone without a paid Apple Developer account. Versions below come from expo/expo@sdk-54 bundledNativeModules.json — do not bump one in isolation.
overridesComment: react-dom arrives transitively (expo-router pulls it for web) and floats to 19.2.x, which peer-requires react ^19.2.8 while SDK 54 pins react 19.1.0. Every plain `npm install` then fails with ERESOLVE. --legacy-peer-deps silences it but has previously pruned react-native-worklets, which Reanimated 4 needs and whose absence only shows up as a bundling error. Pinning react-dom to match react fixes the cause instead.
